environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL associated with ALB containing three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 0 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode and all other rules in BLOCK mode; (2) Priority 1 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with sensitivity level HIGH, all rules in BLOCK mode, inspecting QUERY_STRING, URI_PATH, BODY, and SINGLE_HEADER 'cookie'; (3) Priority 2 - custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP. WebACL default action ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics enabled per-rule with sampled requests retention.

config.logging: WAF logs to Kinesis Firehose -> S3, ALB access logs to S3
